pageDefinitions.description: Provides detailed view and management of an individual customer's master data.
Overview of registered customers, their balances, and sales statistics.
Manage vendor information and agreed business terms, including payment terms, prices, and discounts.
Overview of registered vendors that goods and services are purchased from.
Manage item information, pricing, replenishment, inventory, costing, and posting settings.
Overview of products and services bought and sold, including default prices and inventory tracking.
Create an order with sales lines, then ship or invoice it when ready.
Manage a sales invoice before posting; an unposted invoice can be reopened from the ongoing invoices list.
Create and manage a purchase order for goods and services.
Manage a purchase invoice before posting vendor bills and payable entries.
Sales invoices remain in this list until finalized and posted.
Manage sales orders used for partial shipments, drop shipments, or prepayments.
Track purchase orders through ordering, receipt, and posting.
Create, manage, and post purchase invoices to record vendor bills and update payable, inventory, and financial records.
Offer customers pricing and terms for what you sell. Quotes stay in this list until they're converted to an order or invoice, or deleted.
You can update, send, and resend a quote as needed. If the quote is accepted, the details will transfer to the sales order or invoice you create from it.
Create, manage, and post sales credit memos to process customer refunds, returns, cancellations, and allowances.
Use a sales return order to track receipt and potential refund of items returned by a customer.
Lists posted sales invoices for viewing, printing, and navigation.
Review posted sales shipments and their customer and shipping details.
Review posted sales credit memos and related customer transactions.
Create, manage, and track vendor purchase quotes before converting accepted quotes into purchase orders.
Create and manage purchase return orders to process returns to vendors and reverse posted costs.
Review posted purchase invoices and recorded vendor bills.
Review posted purchase receipts and completed purchase deliveries.
Provides a simplified lookup page for selecting customers.
Provides a simplified lookup page for selecting vendors.
View and select item variants defined for inventory items.
Organize item categories and classify inventory consistently.
Manage and post receipts from purchase orders and other source documents, adjust quantities, and assign bins and locations.
Manage a warehouse receipt document for receiving items.
Manage a warehouse shipment document for outbound goods.
View warehouse shipments prepared for outbound processing.
View warehouse activity documents and their status.
View warehouse put-away activities for placing received items into storage.
Manage item picking for warehouse shipments using assigned pick instructions.
Create and manage inventory picks for outbound source documents.
View production orders in the system.
Track and monitor released production orders and their progress.
Manage a released production order.
The chart of accounts is the core of the financials. It's used to group income and expenses in the income statement and balance sheet.
View posted general ledger transactions and accounting entries.
Enter and post general journal transactions.
Configure core general ledger parameters, posting controls, currency, VAT, and dimensions.
Prepare and post payments, including payment file export and check processing.
Manage bank account master data and payment configuration.
View and manage bank accounts, their balances, reconciliations, and statement imports.
View posted bank transactions and navigate to related documents and reconciliation details.
Reconcile imported bank statement lines with internal ledger entries using automated suggestions and manual review.
Manage and post a sales credit memo to process customer returns, refunds, and corrections.
Manage and post a purchase credit memo for vendor returns, allowances, and corrections.
List purchase credit memos used to manage vendor refunds, returns, and corrections.
Record and post incoming customer payments in a cash receipt journal.
Import, match, review, and post payment reconciliation lines.
